digest.description: A preview of a NOT-YET-SAVED mapping has no stored state to confirm, so the digest is always null.

immediate.description: A not-yet-saved mapping has no grants to revoke; the evaluator's fixed default (group_mapping_preview.rs).

diff.description: email is never null: preview rows exclude cleaned-up users (lifecycle.rs preview_platform_effect/preview_workspace_effect: usr.cleaned_at IS NULL) and an immediate row names only unrevoked grants, which cleanup revokes before clearing the address. A new mapping can only add access: grants are compared with the existing ones, never removed (existing_mapping_id is null), so the *_lost lists are always empty.

immediate.description: The management write's own immediate effect, present with applies:true only when the write would revoke grants (a delete, or a merge that changes a field).

AccessPolicyInput.description: Rates are required-nullable (null clears) for requests_per_minute, tokens_per_minute and concurrent_requests and optional-nullable for the other four; every number is positive within the stated bound. EXACTLY ONE of budgets (the stacked form) or monthly_budget_microusd with an optional budget_period (the deprecated single-budget form) must be present: both, or neither, or budget_period with budgets, are refused. Money is a canonical positive integer micro-USD string. The positional array form can only express the monthly form (the stacked budgets field would be the tenth element, which makes both present): 8 or 9 elements ending at monthly_budget_microusd or budget_period.

AccessWorkspaceAccess.description: Workspace-scoped effective access (GET /workspaces/{ws}/access): no key is bound, so key_id is null, the key layer is the inactive stub (applies=false, null limits/budgets/catalogs/restriction), and the key layer and the key_restriction reason are never emitted. Reason layers are platform (model-level facts), type_default, workspace_override or workspace; budget reasons carry the period.

oneOf.x-omg-unobserved-branch: The accounting report is unavailable only when read_budget_report returns None for a budget_totals row whose counters are negative or mutually inconsistent (governance/totals.rs read_budget_report).
